meta.recheck_method: One read-only page load per listing (CarGurus VDP listingViewPayload / KBB __NEXT_DATA__), plus KBB cross-listing for CG cars where a KBB id was already known. Dealer sites: home + contact/about/staff pages only; no forms touched.
meta.tax_assumptions: WA dealer: sales tax at dealer-city Q3-2026 vehicle rate (Seattle 11.05%, Kirkland 10.80%, Puyallup 10.80%); OR dealer: WA use tax at Seattle 11.05%. Doc WA $200 / OR $250 (untaxed). License/title est. = $300 fixed + RTA 1.1% × approx. MSRP × DOL depreciation (yr4 83% / yr5 74% / yr6 65%). All labelled estimates.
